title: Modified ICP based Framework for 3D Localization and Mapping in GNSS-denied Environments using LiDAR
authors: Koshti M.; Barnwal S.; Goel S.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
